title: Prisma Schema Design
description: Master Prisma schema.prisma structure, datasource, generator, models, field types, and PostgreSQL mappings.
longDescription: This module dives deep into Prisma schema design. You will learn about the schema.prisma file structure, how to configure datasources and generators, how to define models, how Prisma types map to PostgreSQL types, and best practices for designing clean and maintainable schemas.
whatYouLearn: Define models with fields, attributes, and constraints
Map Prisma types to PostgreSQL types correctly
